title: Seven Continents and Five Oceans
summary: Learn the big pieces of land and water that make up our world.

steps.title: The seven continents
sentences: A continent is a very large piece of land.
The seven continents are Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe and Australia.
Asia is the biggest continent, and India is in Asia.

steps.title: The five oceans
sentences: Oceans are huge areas of salty water.
The five oceans are the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic.
The Pacific Ocean is the biggest and the deepest of all.

steps.title: Close to home
sentences: The Indian Ocean touches the south of India.
The Bay of Bengal is on the east side and the Arabian Sea is on the west side.
Chennai is on the coast of the Bay of Bengal.
points: Bay of Bengal in the east

steps.title: Find them on a globe
sentences: A globe is a small model of the Earth.
Blue on a globe or map usually shows water and the other colours show land.
Try spinning a globe and finding all seven continents.
points: A globe is a model of Earth

facts: Antarctica is the coldest continent and has no permanent human residents, only scientists who visit.
About 71 percent of Earth is covered by water.
Australia is both a country and a continent.

quiz.q: Chennai is on the coast of which bay?
quiz.why: Chennai lies on the Bay of Bengal.
